result.summary: Overall the page renders cleanly, but there are a few visual defects: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' restaurant name appears clipped mid-character without an ellipsis, the last category chip on the filter row is cut off with no visual affordance, and the third 'Fastest near you' card title is truncated abruptly. These are mostly text truncation/clipping problems rather than structural breakage.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped mid-glyph (renders as 'Tokumaru Ramei') even though there is ample horizontal space before the rating on the right. Text is being hard-clipped instead of ellipsized.
issues.suggestion: Fix the title container width/constraint so the full name displays, and apply text-overflow: ellipsis (or the platform equivalent) as a fallback for long names instead of hard clipping.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' card title in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off abruptly at the screen edge with no ellipsis, and the card image is partially clipped, which may look broken rather than like an intentional scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add an ellipsis to truncated card titles and consider a peek offset or gradient fade at the carousel edge to signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The last category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge showing only a small sliver, making it look like a rendering artifact.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing so a meaningful portion of the next chip peeks into view, or add a fade/scroll indicator at the edge of the chip row.

issues.description: Delivery time badges ('15-25 min', '20-30 min') overlap the food images inconsistently — the badge on the third card sits partially off-screen due to the clipped card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure badges are fully contained within visible card bounds or hidden when the card is mostly off-screen.
